content:
Dizziness on standing is a common falls trigger.

This guide covers precautions. It is educational information, not a diagnosis or personal treatment plan.

Why dizziness happens

Blood pressure can drop when you stand up.

Simple precautions

  • Sit on the edge of the bed before standing.
  • Drink enough fluids.
  • Use a walking aid.

Medicines review

Ask your GP or pharmacist to review all your medicines.

When to get help

  • Call 999 if you faint and are injured, or have chest pain.

Never stop or change a prescribed medicine yourself. Ask your GP or pharmacist for a review.

Common questions

Should I stop my tablets?

No; speak to your GP.

Can my GP check standing BP?

Yes, ask.

Sources and further reading
